text: Can your landlord just let themselves in?
In Tamil Nadu, the tenancy law draws the line.
They may enter for repairs, an inspection, or a reason in your agreement,
with written notice at least twenty-four hours ahead,
saying why, which day, and a time between seven a.m. and eight p.m.
No notice? Ask them to come back with one. If it keeps happening, the Rent Court can hear it.
